tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /khro phu mkhan chen gyis phul ba'i zhabs brtan rig byed kyi grangs bcas bzhugs// ༄༅/ /sarba dzña dza brti pa ṭu swa ru paṃ tsakra sd+yi rā pa da na ṭā ka ma yaḥ/ sd+yā bhu mi paṇḍu bha ga wā dza gārthe sarba dhya yo dharm+ma tsa ra dza padmaṃ/ ༄༅/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i rang gzugs bcom ldan 'das/ /brtan pa'i 'khor lo sgyu 'phrul zlos pa'i gar/ /'gro mang don du bsgyur mkhas sa skya pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po zhabs pad brtan par gsol/ /'gro la rjes brtse thugs rje'i sprin phung las/ /zab dang rgya che'i chos sgra dbyar skyes rnga/ /bskal bzang mdongs mtha' can gyi dga' ston du/ /sgrogs mkhas kun mkhyen bla ma zhabs brtan gsol/ /rnam mang ting 'dzin chu klung bye ba brgya/ /zung 'jug rgya mtsho'i klong du 'dres pa las/ /dngos grub nor bu'i 'byung gnas sa skya pa/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag zhabs pad brtan par gsol/ /de ltar rtse gcig gus pas gsol btab mthus/ /rje btsun mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag seng ge'i khrir/ /bskal brgyar zhabs kyi padmo brtan pa dang / /phan bde'i rtsa lag thub bstan dar rgyas shog /ces khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' dang rnam dbyer ma mchis pa'i bdag nyid chen po dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhabs kyi padmo rtag brtan 'tsho zhing bzhes pa'i rten 'brel gyi sgo 'phar dbye phyir/ rig byed kyi grangs kyis 'khyud pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di/ dā ri drwa pa kā la pā das gus pas gsol ba btab pa dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ khro phu mkhan chen gyis phul ba'i zhabs brtan rig byed kyi grangs/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
